name: Conquering Countermand
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 6, psychic 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, witch 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a bit of black wool)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect see text
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like dispel magic except you may add your caster level up to a maximum of +20 to the dispel check and you may only use this spell to make a targeted dispel or a counterspell. When you use this spell to make a counterspell attempt you may also make a caster level check with a DC of 25 + twice the level of the spell you are countering, if you succeed you may gain control of that spell. This means you cast the countered spell as an immediate action, treating it as though it had been cast from one of your own spell slots. Using your caster level and calculating save DC as normal for your spellcasting feature.
